scripts.text:
{0}
Hello {1}, do
you want to buy some items?
You'll have to give me Love
Flowers for them, of course!
Yes, sure!
scripts.translation: 是的，当然！

scripts.text: No, never mind.
scripts.translation: 不，算了。

scripts.text:
{0}
You'll need more Love Flowers if you want that!
scripts.translation:
{0}
想要那个的话，你需要更多的爱心花！

scripts.text:
{0}
Are you sure you want to trade ^00aa00{1}x Love Flower ^000000 for ^0055FF{2}^000000?
No, I've changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 不，我改变主意了。

scripts.text: Yes, trade!
scripts.translation: 是的，交换！

scripts.text:
{0}
You have to bring me 15 Love Flowers!
scripts.translation:
{0}
你得给我15朵爱心花！

{0}
非常感谢你把我们的花儿带回来！

{0}
拿这个当作一点“谢礼”吧。

scripts.text:
{0}
If you get more Love
Flowers, you can exchange
them for some sweets here.
See you soon!

{0}
Please bring a +8 Cake Hat
to the Baker Extraordinaire
standing next to me!
scripts.translation:
{0}
请带一顶+8蛋糕帽给我旁边站着的非凡面包师！

scripts.text:
{0}
Hello {1}, it's
Valentine's Day and we
love to deliver sweet
chocolates.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你好 {1}，今天是情人节，我们喜欢送甜巧克力。

scripts.text:
{0}
Our problem is that we
need a strong person
like you who could help
us, but first you'll have
to bring a +8 Cake Hat
to the Baker Extraordinaire, who
is standing right next to me!
scripts.translation:
{0}
我们的问题是，我们需要像你这样强壮的人来帮忙，但首先你得带一顶+8蛋糕帽给我旁边站着的非凡面包师！

scripts.text:
{0}
Hello {1}!

{0}
Exchange your Love Flowers with Pinkamenia!
scripts.translation:
{0}
用爱心花和Pinkamenia交换吧！

scripts.text:
{0}
Bring 15 Love Flowers to Pinkamenia!
scripts.translation:
{0}
带15朵爱心花给Pinkamenia！

scripts.text:
{0}
Ah, so Pinkamenia told you
to bring me the +8 Cake
Hat. Now I'm going
to exchange your +8 Cake
Hat for another Cake Hat.
scripts.translation:
{0}
啊，Pinkamenia让你给我带+8蛋糕帽。现在我要用你的+8蛋糕帽换另一顶蛋糕帽。

scripts.text:
{0}
Sorry, but where is your
+8 Cake Hat? Bring
it to me, and remember
to have it equipped!
scripts.translation:
{0}
抱歉，你的+8蛋糕帽在哪里？
请把它带给我，
记得要装备上哦！

scripts.text:
{0}
Now, if you wear the
new Cake Hat, there
is a chance that
Demi-Human Monsters will
drop a Love Flower!
scripts.translation:
{0}
现在，如果你戴上
新的蛋糕帽，
半人魔物
就有几率掉落爱心花！

scripts.text:
{0}
The mobs stole our Flowers,
which we need to create 
our chocolates. Now get
15 Love Flowers and bring
them to Pinkamenia!
scripts.translation:
{0}
魔物们偷走了我们的花，
那是制作巧克力必需的。
现在去收集15朵爱心花，
带给Pinkamenia吧！
